title: Sidebar Controls improvement — raise criterion from 82 to 90+ (UX scoring matrix)
deliberation_reason: New track created per UX scoring matrix gap analysis; multiple defensible approaches exist (control density, grouping, discoverability, responsive behavior). Must run OSD before committing to a cluster.

phase0.summary: Nominate the Sidebar Controls cluster(s) to improve. Candidates: (a) control density/progressive disclosure — collapse advanced controls behind 'More' or accordion, reduce initial cognitive load, (b) logical grouping — visually group related controls (layout, print, appearance, advanced) with clear section headers, (c) discoverability — tooltip onboarding, empty-state hints, keyboard shortcut hints, (d) responsive behavior — sidebar adapts to narrow viewports, controls reflow without horizontal scroll. Run OSD to pick one cluster for Phase 1.

phase1.summary: Implement the nominated Sidebar Controls improvement cluster. Likely extends js/controls_panel.js or js/properties_panel.js behind existing window.Controls or window.Properties seam. Must pass: eslint clean, npm run lint, all existing unit tests (no regressions), controls_panel.test.js (63 cases) and properties_panel.test.js (38 cases) stay green.

phase2.summary: N/A unless new measured premise (e.g., task completion time metric validated).

phase3.summary: Guard-discipline continuity: injected-scope collision, dead-exports, scripts hygiene, full suite, lint, smoke — all green. Add Sidebar Controls regression test(s) for the new capability.

phase4.summary: Checkpoint + frontier review + consultant verification (3 consultants).

phase5.summary: Register, seal, hand-over. Target: Sidebar Control Quality criterion >= 90 on next UX scoring run.

context.gap_analysis: Sidebar control efficiency rates 82. Likely gaps: control density (too many visible at once), grouping (related controls not visually grouped), discoverability (hidden features), responsive behavior (narrow viewport handling).
context.fleet_certification: ux_feature_fleet_20261029 completed 18/18 tracks; track-03 (controls) at 153e2df, track-12 (properties_panel) at 9fa4cdc
context.handoff_instructions: Fresh session: read this spec + matrix.json + controls_panel.test.js + properties_panel.test.js + js/controls_panel.js + js/properties_panel.js. Run OSD (subspace-deliberation skill) to nominate Phase 1 cluster. Then execute Phase 1 improvement per conductor-protocol.

criteria_note: Draft track: acceptance criteria live in spec.md as [AC-1]..[AC-4] and are NOT sealed. Seal at Phase 5 with `python housekeeping_guard.py seal --track sidebar_controls_improvement_20261103`.
